payload.title: CUTLASS/CuTe re-engineered for PPU (actlize)
payload.summary: CUTLASS 3.6.0 re-engineered for PPU: the vendor's equivalent of CuTe plus the CUTLASS collective builders. `include/cute/arch/` carries `mma_ppu0015.hpp` and `copy_ppu0015_aiu.hpp` (plus PPU0010 variants) which are the PPU tensor-cell MMA atoms and AIU/swizzled copy atoms that replace NVIDIA's `mma.sync` and TMA atoms. PPU0015 is the M890 generation and carries the FP8/FP4 paths. Use this to learn the correct atom, layout, and swizzle vocabulary for a PPU tiling before hand-rolling one. Source: `reference-projects/actlize`.

sections.heading: MMA atoms
sections.gist: `include/cute/arch/mma_ppu0015.hpp` and `mma_ppu.hpp` define the PPU tensor-cell MMA atoms; the shapes they accept bound any tiling choice.

sections.heading: Copy atoms and swizzle
sections.gist: `include/cute/arch/copy_ppu0015_aiu.hpp` and `copy_ppu_aiu.hpp` define AIU loads and the `tsm ld swizzle` shared-memory layouts that avoid bank conflicts on this part.

sections.heading: Worked examples
sections.gist: `examples/08_ppu_basic_tensor_op_gemm`, `examples/09_ppu_gemm_with_collective_builder`, and `examples/100_ppu0015_fp8_gemm` are complete, compiling PPU GEMMs and are the fastest way in.
